Coram : S.B. SINHA*, G.S. SINGHVI
Service law - Promotion - No avenue for certain categories of employees appointed with a statutory body - c Recommendations of Pay Commission- Non-implementation - Challenge to - Writ petition allowed by High Court - During pendency, scheme framed for promotion to selection grade and some thereunder- On appeal held: Employee has a right to be considered for promotion D and not a fundamental right of promotion - It is within the realm of the statutory authority that how the employees would be structured but by reason thereof, it cannot tinker with their essential fundamental right-
Decision Date : 05-02-2008 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 991/2008 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
